**graph:** an incremental update refreshes pixel-mvp's index on a thread of its own while it writes the graph's rows, instead of after them. With `PIXEL_GRAPH_SOURCE_RUBY=hybrid` on antiwork/gumroad, a method inserted mid-file reaches the daemon's graph after 6.0 s instead of 7.6 s (p50; p95 9.2 s to 7.3 s), for about 1.1 s more CPU per update; the default Rust source overlaps the same way.
